mapper.select: SELECT ta.task_id AS taskId, ta.user_id AS assigneeUserId, u.email AS assigneeEmail, u.username AS assigneeName, t.description AS taskDescription, t.deadline AS deadline FROM task_assignment ta INNER JOIN task t ON ta.task_id = t.id INNER JOIN user u ON ta.user_id = u.id WHERE t.status = 0 AND t.deadline IS NOT NULL AND t.deadline >= #{startDeadline,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} AND t.deadline < #{endDeadline,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} AND u.email IS NOT NULL AND u.email != ''
